note: The Qwen3-0.6B attention piece's shape on the Hopper warp-group cell: causal, two query heads per key head, head width 128. The score reads the query from a shared-memory slab filled once ahead of the chunk loop. That slab streams along the query rows, which are also its sibling axis, so a fill that bound the sibling to its block base read query row 0 for every row.

attrs.body:
let f32 v0 = 0.0883883461356163
in0 = load scaled_dot_product_attention_mask_fill_c[0]
in1 = load scaled_dot_product_attention_mask_zero_c[0]
for a0 in 0..16:
    for a1 in 0..512:
        for a2 in 0..512:
            for a3 in 0..128:
                in2 = load x1[0, a0 / 2, a2, a3]
                in3 = load x0[0, a0, a1, a3]
                f32 v1 = multiply(in2, in3)
                acc1 <- add(acc1, v1) over a3
            v2 = multiply(acc1, v0)
            v3 = select:
                in1 when a2 <= a1
                in0 when a1 < a2
            v4 = add(v2, v3)
            acc0 <- maximum(acc0, v4) over a2
        for a2 in 0..512:
            for a5 in 0..128:
                in4 = load x1[0, a0 / 2, a2, a5]
                in5 = load x0[0, a0, a1, a5]
                f32 v5 = multiply(in4, in5)
                acc3 <- add(acc3, v5) over a5
            v6 = multiply(acc3, v0)
            v7 = select:
                in1 when a2 <= a1
                in0 when a1 < a2
            v8 = add(v6, v7)
            v9 = subtract(v8, acc0)
            v10 = exp(v9)
            acc2 <- add(acc2, v10) over a2
        for a6 in 0..128:
            for a7 in 0..512:
                for a8 in 0..128:
                    in6 = load x1[0, a0 / 2, a7, a8]
                    in7 = load x0[0, a0, a1, a8]
                    f32 v11 = multiply(in6, in7)
                    acc5 <- add(acc5, v11) over a8
                v12 = multiply(acc5, v0)
                in8 = load x2[0, a0 / 2, a7, a6]
                v13 = select:
                    in1 when a7 <= a1
                    in0 when a1 < a7
                v14 = add(v12, v13)
                v15 = subtract(v14, acc0)
                v16 = exp(v15)
                v17 = divide(v16, acc2)
                v18 = multiply(in8, v17)
                acc4 <- add(acc4, v18) over a7
            scaled_dot_product_attention[0, a0, a1, a6] = acc4
